Scarcity
Scale of preference
Choice
Opportunity cost

Give reasons why consumer cooperative societies are not popular in Kenya (4mks)
State circumstances under which a manufacturer would transport products using a container (4mks)
Give four functions of advertising agencies (4mks)
What are the assumptions in the circular flow of National Income in a two sector economy (4mks)

Give four principles of public expenditure (4mks)
Outline four ways of classifying goods in an economy. (4mks)
11. Name four documents that must be submitted when registering a company (4mks)
12. State three ways which the prices of goods and services can be determined in an economy other than the price mechanism (3mks)
13. State four ways through which communication can be improved between the
 communicating parties. (4mks)
14. Identify the type of unemployment and the particular solution. (4mks)
15. What are the advantages of using a credit card when purchasing goods and services. (4mks)
 16. The following information relates to Chumah Ltd during the month of March 2017.
 March 7th: Sold an old vehicle for sh.900,000 to Super Motors Ltd on credit.
 March 9th: Sold an old computer for sh. 27,000 to Yannar Ltd on credit.
 March 10th: Purchased a Tractor on credit for sh.600,000 from Sifa Farms Ltd.
 March 16th: Purchased Dining Chairs from Ujumbe Furnitures sh. 90,000 on credit.
 Open a journal proper for Chumah Ltd for the month of March 2017. (4mks)
17. The following information relates to Mkabwa traders Ltd as at 31/12/2015.
 Capital 290,000
 Drawings 35,000
 6 year loan 500,000
 Furniture 600,000
 Closing stock 40,000
 Cash in hand 155,000
 Debtors 100,000
 Bank overdraft 140,000
 Expected: Prepare Mkabwa Traders Ltd Balance sheet as at 31/12/2024 (4 marks)
18. State four factors that influence entrepreneurial practices negatively. (4mks)
19. Give four features of a chain store (4mks)
20. State the importance of warehousing to a consumer. (4mks)
21. Give circumstances under which a producer would sell through a wholesaler. (4mks)
22. Fill in the blank spaces using the following (increase, decrease, No effect) (4mks)
23. State four ways in which the central Bank acts as Banker to the government. (4mks)
24. Use the symbol (tick) where necessary (4 marks)
25. Give ways in which the government creates an enabling business environment (4mks)
